values.note: Book online (ResNexus, linked from storrspond.org) or by phone; payment in advance. Cancelling costs one night, and one more within 3 days of check-in. Check-in 12 noon, check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.storrspond.org/activities/camping/ ('Make an Online Campsite Reservation! Book Today' -> reserve6.resnexus.com; 'Campers may stay for one night or up to one full week. Payment is required in advance'); camping policies (check-in/out, cancellation)

sites.source: Camping page ('Storrs Pond has 17 RV sites and 12 tent sites'); site map legend: 50 ft sites 6, 12-15; 40 ft 1, 9; 30 ft 4, 8, 10, 16; 25 ft 2, 3, 5, 11; 20 ft 7, 17 - 15 of the 17 RV sites take 23 ft+

hookups.source: Site map legend (every RV site is a 'Campsite w/ Electric & Water'; a 'Dumping Station' is marked); camping page ('electrical hook-up for RV's no larger than 50 feet and a dump station'). No page states amperage or sewer at the sites.

facilities.source: Camping page ('a bathhouse with hot showers at no extra charge ... and a dump station'); policies ('Our campers' bathhouse is equipped with bathrooms and hot showers'); site map (water faucets). No operator page mentions laundry (the stored value came from an aggregator).

values.note: Mid-May through Columbus Day (October 12 in 2026, October 11 in 2027).

season.source: https://www.storrspond.org/activities/camping/ ('Storrs Pond Recreation Area offers Tent and RV Camping from Mid-May through Columbus Day')

note: Campground in a non-profit recreation area on the edge of Hanover, with a pond beach, pool, splash pad, tennis, disc golf and trails. The rebuilt bridge on the Reservoir Road entrance is tight for big rigs; RVs over 40 ft are asked to come in by East Wheelock St and Grasse Rd. Two RV sites (7, 17) take only 20 ft. --Claude
summary: storrspond.org camping page + policies + site map: $47 for four (holiday $58, +$10 a person), 17 RV sites (15 take 23 ft+, max 50) with electric + water, 12 tent sites, max stay one week, ResNexus online booking, mid-May to Columbus Day. Price gate passes ($47); Google 4.6/221 (whole recreation area). Transient campground, not long-stay. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - $47.00 a night for an RV site, four people (storrspond.org camping page, current 2026 page); holiday weekends $58 (not the gate night). No gateway needed. Google Maps 4.6 from 221 reviews (the listing is the whole recreation area: pool, beach, tennis, campground - not the campground alone). RV Life tier stored $$$.

LONG-STAY: not applicable - transient only ('Campers may stay for one night or up to one full week'); no seasonal or monthly sites offered. Presence: own website with phone (603) 643-2134 and an online engine.
OWNERSHIP: private confirmed - 'proudly owned and operated by the Hanover Improvement Society, a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization'; a non-profit association, not a town (`local` does not fit).

BOOKING ENGINE: ResNexus (reserve6.resnexus.com) not opened (Incapsula; never opened in the browser per the rules) - per-site lengths and current availability unread; lengths come from the operator's site map.

hookups: electric amperage unknown (no page states it); sewer true (derived from an aggregator) cleared to null - the map types every RV site 'Electric & Water' and marks a dump station. facilities.laundry true (aggregator) cleared to null.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept, weak lead only. The operator map draws RV sites 8, 9 and 10 near the pond's east shore by the campers' bathhouse; spring Esri imagery (43.7253,-72.2632) shows a ~30-45 m pine belt between the clearing there and the pond, and the pads cannot be picked out under the pines. No named site within ~50 m over open ground; no upgrade.

PIN: stored 43.72253,-72.26435 is the office/pool parking at the south end (Google's pin 43.72246,-72.26432 for the whole area). The operator map puts most RV sites ~250-350 m north-north-east, along the east side of the pond around the campers' bathhouse; they cannot be picked out under the pines on Esri, so no exact point is proposed (approximate centre 43.7253,-72.2628 if a move is wanted).
